import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)
os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = "42"

# Load data from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Check if sample submission exists to verify format
sample_sub = None
if os.path.exists("./input/sample_submission.csv"):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

# Prepare features and target
X_train = train_df[features].astype(float)
y_train = train_df[target_col].astype(int)
X_test = test_df[features].astype(float)
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Create hold-out validation split (not stratified due to imbalanced classes)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Train LightGBM classifier with conservative parameters
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=150,
    max_depth=25,
    num_leaves=50,
    min_data_in_leaf=30,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1,
)

# Fit on training data only (not validation)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on hold-out validation set (never seen during training)
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy}")

# Predict on test set
y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_pred_test.astype(int)})

# Save to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(
    f"Class distribution in submission: {submission['Cover_Type'].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}"
)
